FIRST SCHEDULE Exempt bodies
An Act to impose a tax on the income of sample companies.
[1 January 2099]
PART 1
PRELIMINARY
Short title
1. This Act is the Sample Tax Act 2099.
Interpretation
2.—(1) In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires —
“company” means any company incorporated or registered under the Sample Companies Act 2099;
“year of assessment” means the period of 12 months commencing on 1 January 2100 and each subsequent period of 12 months.
(2) A reference in this Act to a deduction under section 4 includes a deduction under section 4A.
PART 2
CHARGE OF TAX
Charge of tax
3.—(1) Tax is payable for each year of assessment on the income of any company accruing in or derived from Singapore.
(2) Income in subsection (1) includes —
(a) gains or profits from any trade; and
(b) dividends, interest or discounts.
Deductions allowed
4.—(1) Subject to section 5, in ascertaining the income of any company, there must be deducted all outgoings and expenses wholly and exclusively incurred in the production of the income.
(2) No deduction is allowed under subsection (1) for capital expenditure.
[Act 5 of 2099 wef 01/01/2099]
Deduction for pre-commencement expenditure
4A.—(1) Despite section 4(1), a company may deduct expenses incurred in the 12 months before the date on which it commenced its trade.
(2) Subsection (1) applies only to expenses that would have been deductible under section 4 if incurred after that date.
5. [Repealed by Act 7 of 2099]
Group relief
6.—(1) A company may transfer its unabsorbed losses to another company in the same group if —
(a) both companies are incorporated in Singapore; and
(b) the companies satisfy the shareholding test in subsection (2).
(2) For the purposes of subsection (1)(b), 2 companies are members of the same group if one owns at least 75% of the ordinary shares of the other.
FIRST SCHEDULE
Section 3(2)
EXEMPT BODIES
1. Any sample charity registered under the Sample Charities Act 2099.
2. Any sample town council.
